search.website_text:
FFXIV Plugin with backend for running raffles in game. ###### FFXIV RAFFLE 4 ALL ######

Plugin
- Project: `FFXIVRaffle4All/FFXIVRaffle4All.csproj`
- Command: `/raffle`
- Stores raffles locally in the plugin config folder as `raffles.json`. Exports are saved as `.xlsx` in `exports`.

Backend + Wheel
- Project: `backend/server.js`
- Run: `cd backend` then `npm install` and `npm start`
- Host link: `/host/{raffleId}/{token}`
- Viewer link: `/view/{raffleId}/{token}`




Server settings to connect for the Test Server

https://ffxivraffle4all.onrender.com/
